_: Scene PLAYIDLE performance (IDEAS §1b 'play animation'): a scene whose actor PLAYS AN IDLE ANIMATION on a phase, not just talks. An `idle` ref on a SceneActionSpec compiles to a SCEN SceneAdapter per-phase OnStart fragment (SF_<scene>.Fragment_<phase>) that runs <alias>.GetActorRef().PlayIdle(<idle>) — the THIRD fragment family after quest-stage + TIF. Decoded from vanilla SF_BardSongsBallad01Scene. CRUCIAL: the engine only RUNS a phase that has a SceneAction, so an idle action also emits a Timer (every vanilla fragment phase carries one) — that Timer both makes the phase fire its fragment AND holds the pose. The supplicant stands ready, kneels in worship while pledging, then rises.
_IDLE_CHOICE: Uses IdleSilentBow 0x0D8734 — a pledge BOW. IMPORTANT lesson: not every IDLE record can be played via PlayIdle. The kneel/pray idles (IdleBlessingKneel*, IdleCrouchedPray*) are FURNITURE/condition-gated — Skyrim only plays them from a shrine, so a free-standing actor.PlayIdle() does nothing (confirmed in-game: `playidle IdleBlessingKneelEnter` = no motion). Pick idles that vanilla SCRIPTS actually PlayIdle (grep the papyrus source for `.PlayIdle(`): IdleSilentBow, IdleStop, IdleGive, IdleApplaud, gesture/offset idles. IdleSilentBow confirmed in-game via `playidle IdleSilentBow`. (Console `playidle` wants the EditorID, not the FormID — but Papyrus PlayIdle(form) takes the form, which this `idle` ref binds.)

packages._: Keeps the supplicant STANDING at his editor location (no chair-seeking) so the scene's kneel idle can play — a free-sandboxing NPC sits on inn furniture and a seated actor ignores PlayIdle. Sandbox template (Skyrim.esm:0x01C254) with sitting/wandering/sleeping/furniture all OFF = stand in place. Mirrors how vanilla PlayIdle scene actors (the bard) are package-controlled, not free-roaming.

quests._: Host quest. StartGameEnabled so the scene (BeginOnQuestStart) is armed; replay it any time with the console: `startscene MF_OathScene` while near the supplicant.
quests.name: ModForge PlayIdle Showcase

scenes._phases: phase 0: a brief standing beat (a Timer — vanilla scenes never put a fragment on phase 0). phase 1: he BOWS (idle OnStart fragment) AND pledges, holding 3s. phase 2: he bows again (idle) AND seals the oath, holding 3s. Each idle action emits a Timer so its phase actually runs.

lines: By the Eight, I pledge my blade and my breath.
And my honor, until the end. The oath is sworn.

scenes._actions: phase 0 = a plain 1.5s Timer beat. phase 1 = bow (IdleSilentBow 0x0D8734) held 3s while pledging. phase 2 = a DIFFERENT gesture (IdleGive 0x0B5E20, an offering) held 3s while sealing the oath. Two distinct PlayIdle-proven idles → both phase fragments are visibly exercised (re-playing the SAME idle back-to-back can read as one gesture, so phase 2 uses a different one).
